description_en: Sets the desired property values for a specified device in batches
description_zh: 调用该接口为指定设备批量设置期望属性值
name: SetDeviceDesiredProperty

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If the instance has an ID, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Instance Overview page or the ID is not displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device whose desired property values you want to set belongs.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要设置期望属性值的设备所隶属的产品ProductKey。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name for which you want to configure Settings of desired property values.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要设置期望属性值的设备名称。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device whose desired property values you want to set. The ID is issued by IoT Platform and uniquely identifies the device.
<notice> IotId is the unique identifier of the device and corresponds to the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要设置期望属性值的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。
<notice> IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The current versions of the desired property values. The parameter is a JSON string that consists of key-value pairs. Example: {"Temperature":2}.

Key: the identifier of the property. You can view the property identifier in the feature definition of the product to which the device belongs in the console.

    > In a single call, the keys (property identifiers) cannot be duplicated.

Value: the current version number of the desired property value.

    When you set a desired property value for the first time, set this parameter to 0. After the first setting, the version number of the desired property value becomes 1. Each time you set a desired property value, IoT Platform automatically increments the version number by 1. For example, when you set the desired property value for the second time, set this parameter to 1. After the setting succeeds, the version number automatically becomes 2. When you set it for the third time, set this parameter to 2. After the setting succeeds, the version number automatically becomes 3, and so on.
    > If the specified version number does not match the current version number, the server rejects the request. If you are unsure about the current version number of the desired property value, you can omit the version number, but you must still pass a valid JSON object, which is {}
parameters.help_zh:
当前期望属性值版本，组成为Key:Value，数据格式为JSON String，例如{"Temperature":2}。

Key取值为属性的标识符（identifier）。可在控制台中，设备所属产品的功能定义中查看属性的identifier。

    > 一次调用中，key的取值（即属性的identifier）不能重复。

Value取值为当前期望属性值的版本号。

    首次设置期望属性值时，指定该参数值为0。首次设置期望属性值后，期望值版本号为1。以后每次设置期望值后，物联网平台自动将期望值版本加1（即第二次设置期望属性值时，指定该参数值为1。设置成功后，版本号自动变为2；第三次设置时，指定该参数值为2。设置成功后，版本号自动变为3；以此类推）。
    > 如果传入的版本号与当前版本不符，服务器将拒绝此次请求。若您不确定当前期望值的版本号，可以不传入版本号，但仍需传入有效的JSON，即传入{}
parameters.name: versions

parameters.help_en:
The desired property values to be set. The parameter is a JSON string that consists of key-value pairs of properties. Example: {"Temperature":35}. You can specify up to 10 desired property values.

Key: the identifier of the property. You can view the identifier in the feature definition of the product to which the device belongs in the console, or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html operation to view the identifier in the returned Thing Specification Language model data.

    If the property is temperature under the custom (non-default) module testFb, the parameter value is {"testFb:temperature":35}.

    > The specified property must be readable and writable. If you specify a read-only property, the setting fails. In addition, you cannot specify duplicate property identifiers in a single call.
  


Value: the desired property value to be set. The value must comply with the data type and value range defined for the property.

    > If you set the property value to null, the desired property value is cleared
parameters.help_zh:
要设置的期望属性值，组成为属性的Key:Value，数据格式为JSON String，例如{"Temperature":35}。最多可输入10个期望属性值。

Key取值为属性的标识符（identifier）。可在控制台中，设备所属产品的功能定义中查看；或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html，从返回的物模型数据中查看。

    如果是自定义（非默认）模块testFb下属性temperature，则参数值为{"testFb:temperature":35}。

    > 指定属性必须是读写型。如果您指定了一个只读型的属性，设置将会失败。并且， 一次调用中，不能传入重复的属性标识符。
  


Value取值为要设置的期望属性值。取值需符合您为该属性定义的数据类型和取值范围。

    > 若属性值设置为null，则表示清空期望属性值
